maddeler.e:
نقترن (form VIII)
# نَقْتَرِنُ (naqtarinu) /naq.ta.ri.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
# نَقْتَرِنَ (naqtarina) /naq.ta.ri.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
# نَقْتَرِنْ (naqtarin) /naq.ta.rin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
